issue_context.title: Adapt ScanDetailV2 in Coprocessor Response
issue_context.body:
## Description

In https://github.com/pingcap/kvproto/pull/600 a new structure `ScanDetailV2` is introduced in TiKV Coprocessor response. The information contained is very useful for troubleshooting, so that it would be nice to be included in:

- EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution info (1000 points)
- Slow Query (500 points)
- Statements (500 points)

## Score

- 2000
